entries.title: Merge cards and pull requests are easier to scan
entries.body: New merge cards and pull requests keep their explanation short, put each view’s before and after pictures together, and show a checklist of what was checked. Longer evidence stays folded, and code versions no longer appear in the story. Both keep the same pull request title.

picture.alt: A short story with change bullets, two reply-view pictures side by side, a checked result and a folded evidence section
